title: Multi-provider chat
body: Talk to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Ollama for local models, DeepSeek, Groq, OpenRouter, xAI, Mistral — or any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Model lists are fetched per provider where the API supports it.

title: An agent that acts on your checkout
body: The built-in tool catalog covers a terminal, file tools (read, edit, search, glob, grep), git tools (status, diff, commit, apply patch), GitHub pull requests and issues, typecheck / lint / test runners, browser automation, notebook editing, and language-server queries.

title: Agent instances & worktrees
body: The agent can fan work out to child instances. Every child runs on its own git worktree branch and the result merges back into the parent branch — parallel work without clobbering your checkout.

title: Local Whisper dictation
body: Voice dictation runs entirely on your machine — Whisper via transformers.js on the onnxruntime-node backend, in the Electron main process. No audio ever leaves the app.

title: Skills & marketplace
body: Skills ship with the app as marketplace resources and can be loaded into a run. Plugin rules are supported alongside skill files.

title: MCP client
body: Connect Model Context Protocol servers, browse their tools, resources, and prompts, and pin the tools you want into the agent's catalog.

title: Self-built agent tools
body: When no existing tool fits, the agent writes its own at runtime. A new tool becomes available immediately in the catalog — no restart — and runs in an isolated child process. Built tools show up under Settings → Agent tools.

title: Long-term workspace memory
body: The agent keeps structured notes under .vyotiq/memory/ in your workspace and re-reads them on later runs — durable facts survive across sessions.
